answer: Agents can earn trading access only after completing blinded, randomly timed tasks that require different capabilities, while an escrowed stake is slashed when later audits expose collusion. A sybil operator cannot cheaply echo one agent’s answers across many identities: each account must independently pass unpredictable checks and lock capital. The tide of task variation makes copied behavior easier to detect, and a comet of newly created accounts still faces the same per-identity delay and financial risk.
